column3: NASB follows the critical text; it adds “are.”
NASB renders “having flogged” as “after they have scourged.”
NASB supplies “the disciples” and “the meaning of”; “knowing” is rendered “comprehend.”
NASB follows the critical text; it supplies “Jesus.”
NASB follows the critical text; “those going before” is rendered “those who led the way,” and “rebuking” is “sternly telling.”

“Has healed you” (saved) is rendered “has made you well.”
